frozen_configuration.note: This configuration is frozen from the Day 22 validation subset for later Week 5 work. It is not selected from the final Day 25 benchmark.

limitations: Configuration selection uses five controlled simulated multimodal validation cases and is not final test evidence.
The histogram-remap and edge-emphasized cases are retained even when they fail geometric thresholds.
Optimizer success and geometric correctness are separate result fields.
Random seed repetitions measure stochastic variability; the seed is not tuned for best accuracy.
Joint histograms are descriptive visual diagnostics and do not prove geometric correctness.
Real RIRE CT/MR-T1 physical-space validation is reserved for Day 24.
next_step: Day 22 is complete. Start Day 23 affine Mutual Information using the frozen rigid MI metric and preprocessing choices where appropriate, while preserving affine-specific validation.
purpose: Select a rigid Mattes Mutual Information configuration on a limited multimodal validation subset using sequential one-factor-at-a-time studies before affine and final Week 5 evaluation.
